offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 计费；每次搜索从 10000 tokens 起，无法精确换算固定千次请求价格
offerings.free_quota: Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC), Free.
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和内容，转换为适合 LLM 的文本；JSON 模式返回五项结构化条目
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；每次请求消耗固定 token，起始为 10000 tokens。
